minutes.headline: Building committee backed asking town meeting for the high estimate, but deferred the final figure pending hazardous-material costs; next meeting March 17.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed publicity on past building spending, the Brooks House and TCP (the former school building), and the Town Hall/Ritter warrant article dollar figure. Members leaned toward putting the architect's high estimate in the warrant, but found the estimate excludes hazardous material removal and other items, so they tabled the final figure and will ask the facilities director and architect. Minutes of two earlier meetings were approved and the meeting adjourned.

public_comment.topic: APDC representative Tony said the architect and engineer reports show Town Hall and Ritter can be renovated; he worried about creating too much new square footage in the Town Hall addition and cited per-square-foot costs for renovation versus new space.
Chair asked for public comment from the public; no one spoke at that point.
Chair again invited public questions or comments; none were heard.
